mapper.select: select pay_type from (select r.pay_type,row_number() over() as rownum from FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE r inner join fin_cash_info c on r.cash_id = c.cash_id where c.finprod_id = #{finprodId, jdbcType = VARCHAR} AND c.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} AND c.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2}) t where t.rownum=1
